_about: JIVO's TDS rules for A/P bills, dictated by Daman and Divjot (Accounts) on 2026-09-17. tds.py reads every number and name below. Amounts are rupees before GST. The rate is always read from SAP's own withholding table (OWHT) of the book; if SAP ever disagrees with the rate written here, tds.py stops instead of guessing.
_deductor_groups: Books added together for a vendor's yearly total. Oil and Beverages are one legal entity; Mart counts alone.
_transport: Vendors in the TRANSPORTER group. A declaration on file = no TDS at all. Every other transporter pays 2% on the whole bill from the first rupee, no threshold, even if the card carries a 1% code.

declaration_received_card_codes.VENDA000108: DELHI PUNJAB CARRIER (no PAN on the card)

_goods: Item bills from any vendor that is not a transporter. 0.1% only on the part of this bill that takes the vendor's yearly purchases (all books of the group, found by PAN) above Rs 50,00,000.
